project.name: LUCENT
project.audience: People who enjoy industrial design, film and cinematic web experiences

provenance.referenceReview: Parent and separate reference analyst reviewed actual materialized video frames in Linux. The analyst reports 4 frames per second across all meaningful phases. This art-director role works from their timestamped brief; no local desktop video playback is claimed.

stack.rendering: Integrator choice; real static site with progressive enhancement

typography.display: System sans-serif, heavy weight; tightly tracked

radius.product: Physical geometry; do not reuse UI radii

motion.primary: Continuous scroll camera choreography of one object
motion.reducedMotion: Static camera; all text and sections readable; no parallax

hero.height: At least one viewport; content must fit mobile without obscuring controls
hero.brandLayer: LUCENT oversized low-contrast/outline type behind object
hero.object: Dark aluminum projector; lens is focal point. Hero object 55–65% desktop viewport width and 75–90% mobile width
hero.headline:
Small object.
Endless cinema.
hero.headlinePosition: Left lower quadrant on desktop; separate top text band on mobile
hero.lighting: Warm amber rim and restrained lens glow across black negative space
hero.navigation: Thin top line: LUCENT mark, Experience / Design / Finishes / Details, Explore CTA
hero.primaryCta: Explore the lens — scroll to next meaningful chapter
hero.secondaryCta: Choose a finish — anchor to finish controls

narrative: Warm hero and three-quarter product silhouette
Macro lens with optical rings and light path; avoid invented technical claims
Metal body / ventilation / portable object details with editorial side composition
Enter the lens: a cool cinematic scene expands to full viewport
Interactive material finishes and visual scenes
Compact design notes/specification study and downloadable concept sheet
forbidden: Generic card grid as the main narrative
Unlicensed source product imagery or branding
Fake checkout, form, stock count, certification or real performance promise

decisions.decision: Use LUCENT, the parent's selected original premium portable projector concept.
decisions.reason: A large optical lens and sculpted aluminum shell support the reference's camera rotation, macro view and warm-to-blue cinematic choreography.

decisions.decision: Treat the object and continuous light as the visual thread across chapters.
decisions.reason: Reference emphasis is a single changing object with bold editorial type, rather than independent reveal cards.

decisions.decision: Clearly describe the work as an independent fictional design concept.
decisions.reason: Interactive finishes/scenes and downloadable design notes are useful real CTA flows without pretending sales or specifications are real.

decisions.decision: Use native/code-generated assets and system typography by default.
decisions.reason: Keep the site original, lightweight, free and independent of paid assets or external font/network dependencies.

accessibility.keyboard: Semantic buttons/links; visible focus; no hover-only information
accessibility.touch: Controls at least 44 CSS px; pointer gestures optional
accessibility.contrast: Text uses foreground/muted tokens against background; accent is not the only state signal
accessibility.fallback: Non-WebGL view retains product depiction, chapter narrative and all controls
